title: Chapter 186 Careless
content:
Chapter 186 Careless

The Chaos Pearl Spirit looked around in confusion, and immediately set his sights on Lu Daosheng.

"Hmm?"

"Are you awake?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng spoke.

The Chaos Pearl Spirit frowned slightly, then slowly floated in front of Lu Daosheng, and said arrogantly: "Hey, do you know who this spirit is?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng had a blank expression on his face.

"I'm talking to you, didn't you hear me?!"

Seeing Lu Daosheng not speaking, the Chaos Pearl Spirit felt that the other party despised him, and suddenly became a little angry.

Finally, Lu Daosheng spoke again.

"Chaos Pearl Spirit, I think you haven't figured out your position yet."

Hearing this, the Chaos Pearl Spirit was slightly stunned.

"I am the Chaos Pearl Spirit! What's your attitude!!"

After reacting, the Chaos Pearl Spirit was immediately furious.

It is unforgivable that a mere human dared to speak so arrogantly about a legendary creature like himself.

Since he was born with intelligence, no matter what kind of powerful person he was, he would be overjoyed and respectful when he saw him.

And this human in front of him.

Haha.

The Chaos Pearl Spirit was about to say something else, but a big hand that he could not resist at all directly grabbed his fate by the neck.

Suddenly, a chill slowly gathered around the Chaos Pearl Spirit.

"I'll give you one last chance to organize your words."

Lu Daosheng looked at the Chaos Pearl Spirit and said coldly.

This time, the Chaos Pearl Spirit didn't dare to say anything harsh again.

Because he had already felt that his breath was slowly fading away.

The other party can erase his intelligence!

Aren't you afraid of retribution? !

But at this time, the Chaos Pearl Spirit obviously didn't have time to think about this problem.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was serious, the Chaos Pearl Spirit looked horrified and quickly said, "Don't be afraid of erasing me, don't."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng let go of the Chaos Pearl Spirit.

"Now, I ask you to answer."

"Why did you get infected with this aura of disaster?"

Without waiting for the Chaos Pearl Spirit to respond, Lu Daosheng asked directly.

"Aura of disaster?"

Hearing this, the Chaos Pearl Spirit was slightly stunned, touched his belly, and then exclaimed: "It's gone!"

"That damn aura is gone!"

At this moment, the Chaos Pearl Spirit was extremely surprised.

I didn't expect that after sleeping, the damn aura had disappeared.

"Hahaha, it's still me, a mere aura of disaster, how can this spirit be all!"

Obviously, the Chaos Pearl Spirit thought that the aura of disaster in his body could be dispelled by himself.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's face was ugly.

"If you don't answer again, believe it or not, I will help you get rid of the aura of disaster, and then get it back for you."

Lu Daosheng's cold voice suddenly sounded from the scene.

And the smile on the face of the Chaos Pearl Spirit also froze instantly.

"You, is it you?"

However, the Chaos Pearl Spirit immediately shook his head.

"Impossible, impossible, that is the aura of disaster. Even this spirit can't do anything about it. How can you, "

The Chaos Pearl Spirit didn't finish, but his face was full of disbelief.

Looking at the Chaos Pearl Spirit's expression that looked even more annoying than Ao Qing, Lu Daosheng couldn't bear it anymore.

I saw Lu Daosheng stretched out his hand.

The Chaos Pearl flew directly into Lu Daosheng's hand.

"System, give me a aura of disaster!"

Lu Daosheng said in his heart.

[Received, host]

Suddenly, as the space in front of him trembled slightly, the next moment, a breath that made people feel extremely uncomfortable appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

Boom!

In an instant, the entire space began to collapse inch by inch.

From a very far distance, this place has turned into a dark and deep black hole, and no one can set foot here.

At the same time, somewhere in the distant world.

A little girl with a thin figure was curled up in a hall, looking at the indescribable power in front of her with horror.

"I, I didn't do anything bad, I didn't even go out of the door, you, what do you want to do?"

The little girl's voice was trembling, and she was obviously extremely afraid of the strange power in front of her.

She was not weak at all, on the contrary, she was very strong.

And because of this, she knew how terrifying this strange power was.

Around her, some strange gases were constantly emitting at this moment. These were not intentional by her, but they had turned the entire area into a real life restricted area.

At this time, the power began to slowly approach her.

Seeing this, the little girl's face was pale, and she had no way to retreat, so she had to lower her head tightly.

Buzz——

A wave of space fluctuations came, and the little girl's body trembled slightly, and slowly raised her head.

But she found that the power had disappeared.

Suddenly, the little girl collapsed on the ground, gasping for breath after surviving the disaster.

"Woo woo woo, this Lord of Disaster, whoever wants to do it can do it, I'm scared to death."

.........

"Disaster Air!!!"

In front of Lu Daosheng, the Chaos Pearl Spirit saw the Disaster Air in Lu Daosheng's hand and screamed.

"Oh? You still recognize it."

Looking at the Chaos Pearl Spirit who was trembling all over and pale at this time, Lu Daosheng sneered.

Then, Lu Daosheng grabbed the wisp of Disaster Air that the system picked up from somewhere with one hand and slowly approached the Chaos Pearl.

Seeing this, the Chaos Pearl Spirit could no longer remain calm.

"You, don't come over here!!"

"Go away, go away quickly!!"

The Chaos Pearl Spirit struggled desperately, but the original body was grabbed by Lu Daosheng and could not escape at all.

"Wait, wait a moment."

"Big Boss, I believe it, I believe it. You helped me drive away the disaster energy in my body. Xiao Ling has no choice but to repay me. I hope that from now on, I will work hard for everyone!"

At this time, the Chaos Pearl Spirit finally reacted and immediately hugged Lu Daosheng's thigh and started crying.

"hehe."

Lu Daosheng sneered, but he still put away the ray of disaster.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng felt a hint of chill in his left hand.

This strand is even more terrifying than the last disaster.

The system really has you.

"Okay, now let's talk about how you are infected with the disaster."

After calming down, Lu Daosheng continued to ask this question.

This time, the Chaos Pearl Spirit did not say anything nonsense.

"Big Boss, I can't remember many of the things I've had before. I just remember that I was wandering in a chaotic void area at that time, and then I was about to leave there, but the time and space there were very unstable, and all the messy things went out "

Speaking of this, a hint of anger appeared on the face of the Chaos Pearl Spirit.

"There is a ray of disaster mixed in it."

"Oh, my spirit couldn't dodge enough, so I accidentally got into trouble."

After saying that, the Chaos Pearl Spirit sighed heavily again.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

This is very interesting.

"Where is Yan Lingyun, how did you meet her?"
